title: Privacy Policy
description: How The Daily Meridian collects, uses and protects personal data, including cookies and third-party advertising.

body.html: Template notice. This policy is a starting template and not legal advice. Review it with a qualified professional and adapt it to the laws that apply to you (for example GDPR or CCPA) before publishing.

body: This website is operated by The Daily Meridian Media Ltd ("we", "us"). This policy explains what personal data we collect when you use the site, how we use it and the choices you have.

items: Server logs. Our hosting provider records IP addresses, browser type and pages requested for security and performance purposes.
Preferences. If you switch between light and dark mode, your choice is stored in your browser's local storage. It is never sent to us.
Correspondence. If you email us, we keep your message to respond to it.
Newsletter. The newsletter sign-up on this demonstration site does not collect or transmit any data.

body: We may use third-party advertising services such as Google AdSense. These providers may use cookies or similar technologies to show advertisements based on your prior visits to this or other websites. You can opt out of personalised advertising through Google Ads Settings and learn more at How Google uses information from sites that use its services.
Where required by law, we will ask for your consent before setting non-essential cookies.
We do not currently use analytics tools. If we introduce them, this policy will be updated.
We use data to operate and secure the website, respond to enquiries, comply with legal obligations and, where applicable, display advertising.

Depending on where you live you may have the right to access, correct, delete or restrict the processing of your personal data, and to object to processing or request portability. To exercise these rights, contact privacy@example.com.
We keep personal data only for as long as necessary for the purposes described above or as required by law.
Our articles link to external websites. We are not responsible for the privacy practices of other sites.
We may update this policy from time to time. The date of the latest revision is shown at the top of this page.
